subject: Hyperparameters for rw1 and SPDE models

messages.author: 1365c78a05926ca7
messages.subject: Hyperparameters for rw1 and SPDE models
parts:
Hi all,

I am new to INLA but am hoping to use it for species distribution modelling. I have built a model that works fine using environmental covariates, but I want to include a distance-based covariate to check for point clustering. I have used this Illian 2013 paper as a guide:

http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/2041-210x.12017/full

The paper warns that it is important to consider the hyperparameters for spatial effects and the distance covariate (referred to as a "constructed covariate" in the paper), or else the signal from the fixed environmental covariates could be lost. Unfortunately, that appears to be the case for me. I have fitted a model with 14 environmental covariates, of which 12 are significantly different from 0. When I include the distance covariate using the "rw1" model, however, this number drops to 3. There is no indication of how to select the hyperparameters in the paper of appendix, and as a newbie to Bayesian methods, I seem to have hit a wall. I have tried playing around with different hyperparameters as well as other arguments such as scale.model and inla.group but it has been to no avail thus far. Furthermore, I've also tried to model the latent Gaussian field using an SPDE model, and a similar culling of significant variables happens.

Does anyone have any guidelines for choosing the hyperparameters of the "rw1" model and the SPDE model?

Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Ian
